verdict.rationale: Bruno ships an official, documented CLI (@usebruno/cli) that can run collections headlessly and be scripted/integrated into CI/CD, which functions as a programmatic interface for driving the product; hands-on probe confirms it installs via npm and runs headlessly. However, there is no true public REST/OpenAPI-style API (probe explicitly found no openapi.json/swagger.json), so 'AI-native' agents must shell out to a CLI rather than call a documented HTTP API. Missing for 10: a genuine documented HTTP/REST or SDK-style public API, and independent confirmation of AI/agent usage beyond CI scripting.
